units.source_excerpt: The bar chart is beyond our expectations. Even a step of 30 is far from what LSTM alone needs. For the version with transfer learning, a step around 10 already suffices, and a larger step may even reduce the accuracy
units.function: report the result that reverses the intuition
units.reusable_pattern: Beyond our expectations. Far from. Already sufficient, and may even risk.
information_order: beyond our expectations, far from, already sufficient, may even
prohibited_generalizations: Do not assume more data helps.

units.source_excerpt: We suggest a step of 10 to 15 balls for a five-set match. Under a limited training set, blindly increasing the step fails to help and risks the credibility of the prediction
units.function: turn the chart into a range and a warning
units.reusable_pattern: As a result, we suggest, try to use. Blindly increasing, not only fails, but also risks.
information_order: as a result, we suggest, blindly increasing, not only, but also
prohibited_generalizations: Do not give a point when the chart gives a range.

units.source_excerpt: In more intuitive terms, each point correlates more with the local context than the global one. Coaches may want to attend to the first two or three sets, and the overall trend is more likely to misjudge the situation
units.function: translate the step size into coaching advice
units.reusable_pattern: In more intuitive terms. May want to. It is actually more likely to.
information_order: in more intuitive terms, may want to, more likely to
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave a sensitivity result inside the model.

units.source_excerpt: The deviation reaches its minimum when the number of clusters is 3. Therefore, we divide all matches into three categories. With a much bigger dataset, we will explore this further
units.function: let the minimum choose the number
units.reusable_pattern: Reaches its minimum when. Therefore, we choose. In future work, we will further explore.
information_order: reaches its minimum, therefore, in future work
prohibited_generalizations: Do not pick the cluster count before the scan.

units.source_excerpt: To tennis coaches and players, from MCM team 2406324, dated February 6th 2024, on utilizing momentum analysis for enhanced performance
units.function: give the memo its four-line header
units.reusable_pattern: To, From, Date, RE.
information_order: to, from, re
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open a memo without its header.

units.source_excerpt: This memorandum summarizes our findings, drawing on a comprehensive analysis. Our research underscores the impact of momentum swings and provides actionable strategies. Readers are directed to the sections of the full paper
units.function: summarize and point back to the paper
units.reusable_pattern: Summarizes our findings, drawing on. Underscores, and provides. Readers are directed to.
information_order: summarizes, drawing on, underscores, are directed to
prohibited_generalizations: Do not make the memo repeat the paper.

units.source_excerpt: Our analysis unequivocally demonstrates that momentum significantly influences the flow and the outcomes. An increase correlates with improved performance, while a decrease often precedes a shift
units.function: state the finding in both directions
units.reusable_pattern: Unequivocally demonstrates that, significantly influences. Correlates with, while, often precedes.
information_order: unequivocally demonstrates, correlates, while, precedes
prohibited_generalizations: Do not give the finding in one direction only.

units.source_excerpt: Encourage mental toughness, particularly where momentum is not in the player's favor. Visualization, positive self-talk, and stress reduction can be invaluable in maintaining composure
units.function: give the first recommendation with its techniques
units.reusable_pattern: Encourage, particularly in. Can be invaluable in.
information_order: encourage, particularly, can be invaluable
prohibited_generalizations: Do not advise without a situation.

units.source_excerpt: Leverage match data to identify patterns in opponents that could lead to momentum shifts, and develop strategies to exploit these opportunities
units.function: turn the data into a scouting task
units.reusable_pattern: Leverage, to identify, that could lead to. This involves, and developing.
information_order: leverage, to identify, this involves
prohibited_generalizations: Do not tell a coach to watch without saying for what.

units.source_excerpt: Incorporate scenarios in training that mimic momentum shifts. This will help players adapt, enhancing their ability to respond to both positive and negative swings
units.function: move the finding into practice
units.reusable_pattern: Incorporate scenarios that mimic. This will help, enhancing.
information_order: incorporate, that mimic, this will help
prohibited_generalizations: Do not leave the advice off the practice court.

units.source_excerpt: By recognizing the signs of momentum shifts and preparing strategies, coaches and players can gain a competitive edge. It is essential to integrate momentum management into training regimes
units.function: close on the edge and the duty
units.reusable_pattern: By recognizing, and preparing, can gain. It is essential to integrate.
information_order: by recognizing, can gain, it is essential to
prohibited_generalizations: Do not close a memo without the action.

units.source_excerpt: Twenty-six references, several on fields far from tennis, and the first of them a paper on dietary data
units.function: keep the list including the unrelated items
units.reusable_pattern: The list runs to, and includes.
information_order: runs to, includes
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop a reference for being off topic.

units.source_excerpt: The women's data is cited as a web address with no date, and two names are split across their own papers
units.function: keep the unfinished citations unfinished
units.reusable_pattern: Cited as, with no date.
information_order: with no date
prohibited_generalizations: Do not complete a citation the paper left short.

units.source_excerpt: The appendix prints the training script: a 70 percent split, a step of 6, three LSTM layers of 32, 32 and 16, two dense layers, 60 epochs, and the transfer options that freeze layers
units.function: record the code as the specification the prose omitted
units.reusable_pattern: The listing sets, and.
information_order: the listing sets
prohibited_generalizations: Do not ignore numbers that appear only in code.
